answer: Make identity cost capital. Each agent stakes a bond whose anchor is a slow unlock: stake today, recover it only after months of uninterrupted service. When one wallet funds many bonds, the links surface and every bonded identity forfeits a slice. A fleet then needs aged capital per copy, not one rich wallet, so operators cannot forge scale cheaply. The zephyr of instant copy-paste agents dies once each clone locks real stake for a long season. Cost per identity, not identity checks, does the resisting.
